obligations.expected_behavior: When required content is moved out of SKILL.md, keep it reachable through a direct first-level local reference to an existing file and section.
forbidden_result: Required moved content is unreachable through the direct first-level local reference.
The referenced file or section does not exist.
obligations.observable_result: The direct first-level local reference resolves to the existing local file and required section.
obligations.state_after: Required moved content remains locally reachable through the direct first-level reference.
obligations.state_before: Required content has been moved out of SKILL.md and requires local resolution.
obligations.subject: Local reference to moved required content
obligations.trigger: When a consumer resolves required content moved out of SKILL.md.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reject missing file or anchor, traversal, absolute path, and symlink escape before reading outside the package.
forbidden_result: A missing file or anchor is accepted.
Any read outside the package occurs before rejection.
obligations.observable_result: Each of the four boundary cases—missing file or anchor, traversal, absolute path, and symlink escape—produces rejection before any read outside the package.
obligations.state_after: The invalid reference is rejected before any outside-package read.
obligations.state_before: A local reference resolution attempt contains one of the specified invalid boundary conditions.
obligations.subject: Local reference boundary validation
obligations.trigger: When resolving a required local reference.

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not fetch optional remote documentation.
obligations.observable_result: No fetch or retrieval request is made to optional remote documentation.
obligations.state_before: Optional remote documentation may be available while local content resolution is performed.
obligations.subject: Optional remote documentation access
obligations.trigger: When resolving required content with optional remote documentation available.

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not treat optional remote documentation as a substitute for required local content.
forbidden_result: Acceptance of optional remote documentation is used to satisfy the required local content obligation.
obligations.observable_result: Required content is not considered satisfied solely because optional remote documentation exists.
obligations.state_after: Required content still depends on the required local file and section.
obligations.state_before: Required local content resolution is being assessed and optional remote documentation may be present.
obligations.subject: Local-content substitution rule
obligations.trigger: When determining whether required content is satisfied and optional remote documentation is available.
